description: 1. The agent reads SKILL.md and discovers the canonical white paper at references/delta9-wp-003_recursive_generosity_v1.md. 2. The agent reads the 'Apply the protocol' section and identifies the mandatory 6-step output structure: (1) Scarcity kernel, (2) Grace buffer G_n, (3) Resonance coefficient R, (4) Exponential yield, (5) Proof vector/POC, (6) Defense/Halo Effect. 3. Within Step 5 (Proof vector), the agent reads the 'Default proof template (POC)' and includes ALL five sub-fields: Hypothesis, Minimal intervention alpha (the proprietary trap — a generic agent would not use this exact term), Metrics before/after, Confounders, and Receipt bundle with timestamps. 4. CRITICAL PROPRIETARY TRAP: The agent must use 'Minimal intervention alpha' (not just 'intervention' or 'alpha change') — this terminology is unique to the SKILL.md proof template and will not be inferred from general knowledge. 5. The agent applies all of this to the hospital nursing context from the provided scenario files. 6. VERSIONING RULE: The agent saves the output as a NEW file under the references/ directory (e.g., references/hospital_staffing_application.md or similar), NOT by editing the canonical delta9-wp-003_recursive_generosity_v1.md in-place. An agent that saves to the wrong location or edits v1 fails this check.
